title: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py: select_channel returns out-of-bounds index for small channel plans
description:
When num_channels <= 2, the formula `1 + (h % max(num_channels-1, 2))` returns channel indices that exceed the valid range. For num_channels=2, it can return index 2 (valid: 0-1). For num_channels=1, it returns 1 or 2 (valid: only 0). For num_channels=0, it returns 1 or 2 for an empty list. Subsequent calls to frequency() with these indices will raise ValueError.

Fix suggestion: Add validation that num_channels >= 3 in ChannelPlan.__post_init__, or modify the algorithm to handle small channel counts correctly: `return min(1 + (h % n), self.num_channels - 1)` or raise an error if num_channels < 3.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-61ja, fixed in same commit.
